description: This file contains the implementation of the CodeValueReadPlatformService interface for accessing code value data from a database. It includes methods to retrieve code values by code, by ID, and all code values associated with a specific code ID, utilizing JDBC templates and caching.

classes.name: CodeValueReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for reading code value data from the database, with caching and security checks.

classes.name: CodeValueDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL query results to CodeValueData objects.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValuesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active code values filtered by the specified code, with caching.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodeValues
methods.description: Retrieves all code values associated with a specific code ID, with caching.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific code value by its ID, throws exception if not found, with caching.
